audience: merch sellers, creators and shops that sell products and memberships on Fourthwall

useCases.title: Review recent orders
useCases.text: List orders by time window or status, newest first. Open one order to read its amounts and ordered offers. Orders hold customer names and addresses.

useCases.title: Check stock of a product
useCases.text: List the products with their state and availability. Read the stock of each variant of one product.

useCases.title: Review members and donations
useCases.text: List the membership tiers and the paying members. List the donations the shop received. Member data holds names and emails.

useCases.title: Mark a product sold out or hidden
useCases.text: Mark one product sold out, or available again. Hide a product from the storefront, or show it again. Shoppers see a sold-out change at once.

useCases.title: Browse collections and their products
useCases.text: List the collections with their slugs and states. List the products in one collection, optionally filtered by status.
